name: alternate oblique crunch
source_instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.
interpretation: Five-second controlled alternating oblique crunch. Bent knees and both grounded feet are a compatible authored staging choice; the source does not prescribe tabletop legs or pedalling. Upper-trunk curl and axial rotation bring each elbow toward the opposite knee while separate relaxed palms cradle the occiput and fingers stay relaxed. Hands travel with the head and do not pull the neck. The elbow approaches rather than forcing contact with the knee. Numerical timing, stance and range are authored illustration choices.
